# CYBERAWARE 3D — Runnable Demo

This folder is the static runtime distribution. It contains the application, learning data, scripts/captions/storyboards/prompts and any approved media assets.

Requirements: Node.js 22.23.5 or later. Start with `node server.mjs` and open `http://127.0.0.1:4173`.

The project source archive contains the tests and video authoring/import commands. This static demo does not submit jobs to an AI provider.
